svg.title: One command, authorized stage by stage
svg.desc: A signed intent, an independently held lease and trusted state enter validation, a pure policy decision, a fresh Gate-owned frame, synchronized evidence and a recheck before one publisher call with exact bytes. DENY or ERROR creates no new command and cancels no older one. After the call, receipt, validation, acceptance, selection, application and observation are separate facts owned by others. A recovered PublishCalled without a terminal record becomes UnknownAfterPublish.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: ONE COMMAND, AUTHORISED STAGE BY STAGE
DENY or ERROR: no new command; an older command is
not cancelled; no automatic hold or emergency stop
After the call: separate facts, observed by different owners
Haldir observes only its own call; a returned call is not delivery, and delivery is not application
a recovered PublishCalled without a terminal record becomes UnknownAfterPublish and blocks new decisions
